# Election update: Thursday, November 19 (morning)

## Bottom line
Rep. Nick Begich (R) won Alaska's at-large House seat in ranked-choice tabulation, the state's report shows, and NBC News reports his re-election ([Alaska Division of Elections](https://www.elections.alaska.gov/enr/26GENR/results/RCV-USRep.pdf); [NBC News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxPcjZJTkMzZTVMejZ5QXhmNVlWX3VXdy1XNEV3TTdLWjJKN2FXWWlqQktuRURyMDQ1V2prTHZBQm9YaVpRWnpPZzlkUjd3T0NsZkpvOVBjZF9ON3lrV1VPMVhMNWxqdGtPX1BTTlpYUXlfUE5kZ0FMUHk2NG5BYTZnRVJJTmVMMUNYeUU0WXRsT0VVaUtHcmY5d2o1eTFocVJuSnJLWnExUlU2Nk1QWTllMGxybURMblZnS2lGZ0ZLMThrZmlyb29r?oc=5)). The House results table now marks 433 of 435 races called: D 260, R 173, with 218 needed for a majority ([House table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections)). Two House races remain, NC-05 and MN-01, and both are headed to or in recounts. Every Senate race is called: D 56, R 44, counting seats not up ([Senate table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_Senate_elections)). Governorships are final at D 30, R 20 of 50, counting the 14 states with no race this year, with six flips, all to Democrats ([governor table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_gubernatorial_elections)). Eight seats rated safe came in within 5 points; Democrats flipped TN-04, and Republicans held the other seven (six in the results table, plus CA-23 per [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-elections/california-us-house-district-23-results); TN-04 per [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-elections/tennessee-us-house-district-4-results)).

## Called since the last update
- **Hold (1, R): HOU-AK-AL** (Lean R). In the state's ranked-choice report (tabulated Nov. 18, 5:20 p.m.), Begich won the final round 140,346 (51.35%) to 132,961 (48.65%) for Bill Hill (nonpartisan) ([Alaska Division of Elections](https://www.elections.alaska.gov/enr/26GENR/results/RCV-USRep.pdf)). He led the first round with 47.56%. When Eric Hafner (D) was eliminated, 10,693 of his ballots moved to Hill, 1,627 to Begich, and 11,465 ranked neither. NBC News describes the win as a rare bright spot for Republicans ([NBC News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxPcjZJTkMzZTVMejZ5QXhmNVlWX3VXdy1XNEV3TTdLWjJKN2FXWWlqQktuRURyMDQ1V2prTHZBQm9YaVpRWnpPZzlkUjd3T0NsZkpvOVBjZF9ON3lrV1VPMVhMNWxqdGtPX1BTTlpYUXlfUE5kZ0FMUHk2NG5BYTZnRVJJTmVMMUNYeUU0WXRsT0VVaUtHcmY5d2o1eTFocVJuSnJLWnExUlU2Nk1QWTllMGxybURMblZnS2lGZ0ZLMThrZmlyb29r?oc=5)).
- **SEN-AK update:** the state's final count of Nov. 18 keeps Mary Peltola (D) above a first-choice majority, at 144,486 votes (50.13%) to 131,965 (45.79%) for Sen. Dan Sullivan (R) ([Alaska Division of Elections](https://www.elections.alaska.gov/enr/26GENR/results/ElectionSummaryReportRPT.pdf)).

## Still uncalled
Both remaining races are in the House.
- **HOU-NC-05** (Likely R): the race is moving to a recount at Rep. Virginia Foxx's (R) request, NC Newsline reports ([NC Newsline](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxQSElLbjR5c1NjdV81VExZWnJlcVZ0WGFUWmtkSXR3ZkUtMEVhNUZ1Tzd4eHVQZ1kyVTgwZEloQVhTTmxITTNoMkhZb1JpbzhYVmdSbFA1VHU1MHgyNUhhc3hLQmNtUFhMOGJ0YXVodUdtaGg2OWs5cWN4bVFhZ0YzY2N0eklfRnFrYU5ybzdNeWVxZV93MDZmb3ZDM1BJWTgtSnVucURhdmk?oc=5)), in her race against Chuck Hubbard (D). WFMY reports Foxx has filed as a candidate for 2028 while the recount is pending ([WFMY](https://news.google.?oc=5)).
- **HOU-MN-01** (Lean R): Jake Johnson (D) leads Rep. Brad Finstad (R) by 322 votes, per the Secretary of State as reported by KTTC ([KTTC](https://www.kttc.com/2026/11/16/lead-rochester-data-center-hundred-million-dollar-deficits-olmsted-county-priorities-election-recounts/)). The State Canvassing Board meets today, Nov. 19, which opens the window to request a recount ([KTTC](https://news.google.?oc=5)).

## Recounts and certification
- **North Dakota:** the state canvassing board certified results, with one state House race qualifying for a recount, Valley News Live reports ([Valley News Live](https://news.google.?oc=5)).
- **Arizona:** Maricopa County's board and recorder clashed over the canvass meeting, FOX 10 reports ([FOX 10](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxOdk1Mb0ljZE83MVFaWFRwREE5dTN4NHB1THVDcndVczlKNkFxdXFRVUY3R3Q1em1DdEV4bk9MSmI5dmJtM1hRWFFzdkVkOThmX3FzQnpwS2xZQnhoYjBWLVRmbXJYajlMQm5EaXFwZlFRRnU1OFFyWXRBVGswa1NZeHBiVGFTS1FPT2NVMXhYNzBEU0Z2SGczbzJPZlpzeVAtTUE?oc=5)).
- **Alaska:** certification is slated for Nov. 25, Alaska Public Media reported ([Alaska Public Media](https://alaskapublic.org/news/politics/elections/2026-11-13/peltola-leads-in-u-s-senate-race-nearing-50-mark-with-almost-all-ballots-counted)).
